title: The bell register
text: At midnight the station bell rang although the rope had been cut. The register says the brass clapper had been removed that afternoon. No metal could have struck metal.

title: The heating invoice
text: The heating engineer replaced a steam valve below the platform. His note warns that cooling pipes can knock three times after the boiler shuts down.

title: The keeper’s lamp
text: Keeper Mara placed an amber lantern in the east window every evening. She promised the last train driver there would always be a light to guide him home.

title: The electrical inspection
text: An inspector disconnected the station electricity at sunset. The amber glow later seen in the east window came from a wick and oil, not a wire.

title: The final timetable
text: The final passenger train departed at 21:40. The line closed permanently at midnight. No train was scheduled to arrive after the last departure.

title: The snow report
text: Fresh snow covered the rails before dawn. A visitor heard wheels on the track, but the snow held no wheel marks. Two small bootprints crossed toward the east window.

title: The unsent letter
text: Mara wrote to her brother, the last train driver: I know you cannot return. I keep the lamp for the evenings when I forget. The letter was folded but never posted.

title: The family portrait
text: A portrait shows Mara and her brother repairing a paper lantern. On the back she wrote: He taught me that a small light is enough if someone is looking for it.

title: The bakery receipt
text: The platform kiosk bought six loaves, cinnamon buns and a sack of flour. The baker refused payment for the last bun, then left on the afternoon train.

title: The station garden
text: The station gardener planted rosemary beside the waiting room. The plants survived winter under an old glass cover. Nobody recorded a ghost in the garden.

title: The stopped clock
text: The waiting room clock stopped at 23:58. A broken spring lay in its case. The wall carried a pale rectangle where a second clock had once hung.

title: The visitor’s card
text: A visitor returned twenty-five years later and found an amber light in the east window. The station roof was gone. Someone had left a fresh letter beneath the lantern.
